intro:
A highlight that sweeps through text and content, for loading, thinking and streaming states.

The content is used as a mask and a gradient band is swept behind it on the UI thread, so the highlight is clipped to the glyph shapes — the letters catch the light rather than sitting under a passing overlay.

For a placeholder where there is no content yet, use [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton).
usage:
<Shimmer>Thinking…</Shimmer>

<Shimmer duration={1400} textClassName="text-lg font-medium">
  Generating response…
</Shimmer>

// Mask arbitrary content instead of a string.
<Shimmer as="view" className="w-full gap-2">
  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
</Shimmer>
notes:
The sweep runs entirely on the UI thread and never re-renders React while animating.

It stops when the OS reduce-motion setting is on, and when `enabled` is false — in both cases the content renders statically in `baseColor`.

`baseColor` and `shimmerColor` default to the theme's muted-foreground and foreground tokens, so the effect reads correctly on any surface without configuration. `color` and `intensity` still work but are deprecated in favour of the two colour props.

examples.title: A thinking indicator
examples.description: The default. The sweep is clipped to the glyphs, so the letters catch the light instead of sitting under a passing band.

examples.title: Masking a subtree
examples.description: `as="view"` masks the sweep to whatever you pass instead of to a string.
examples.code:
<Shimmer as="view" className="w-full gap-2">
  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" />
</Shimmer>

examples.title: Tuning the sweep
Custom colours
examples.description: Both default to theme tokens, so you only need these on a surface the tokens do not suit.

examples.title: Turning it off
examples.description: Renders the content statically in `baseColor`. Useful for stopping the sweep the moment a stream finishes, without swapping components.

previewVideo.alt: A screen recording of the Shimmer demo on a dark phone screen. A band of light sweeps repeatedly through the words of “Generating response…”, “Thinking…” and “Searching the web”, lighting each letter as it passes, then through further rows demonstrating a ping-pong sweep, a right-to-left sweep, a wider slower band, a disabled row that stays still, and two colour variants.
previewVideo.caption: The sweep is clipped to the glyphs, so the letters catch the light rather than a box over them.
